scope: Read-only inspection of acquisition/controller/summary source and recorded bounded coverage-check evidence. No numerical, observational or network rerun; no source/input mutation.
checks: Corrected routing POST removes only unsupported option headers; unchanged exact channel/time selection lines retain original request hashes and native attachments.
Acquisition retains the complete 14262-pick and 44718-pair cohort; known CMW1 routing gaps and supported no-span replies remain explicit inventory outcomes, not exclusions.
Authoritative response/request hashes, source URL, native pick/event/origin/association identities, full NSLC/FDSN identities and both native metadata epochs are retained.

Terminal summary requires completed stages and all batches, verifies raw/request/provenance hashes, exact original native request windows, one coverage row per original pick and complete native readback.
Offline provider_coverage compares parsed pointers, NSLC, quality, finite positive sample rates and timespans directly with raw JSON; each covering index is rederived from original request windows.
Pair summaries join through original pick resource IDs and verify both event/origin/pick/arrival and native epoch associations.
No reported span is interpreted as decoded waveform coverage, response calibration, correlation acceptance or a newly measured differential observation.
resolved_review_limitation: The first summary draft trusted parsed covering indices by hash. The final offline function rederives those indices from raw reported spans; the live acquisition/controller were unchanged.
operational_limitations: run_inventory.py does not install SIGTERM/process-group cleanup. If interrupted, inspect controller and child state before recovery; do not infer completion or restart while a child may still be live. This review does not request mutation of the current live controller.

The inventory uses reported contiguous spans and a half-open request convention. Exact sample-grid alignment, gaps/overlaps, quality and actual waveform identity still require standard waveform decoding.
The inventory is still active at review time; this source review is not a terminal inventory audit or evidence of complete availability.
